label: violation
policy_basis: Corporations Act 2001 (Cth); Privacy Act 1988 s 6 personal information
description: A {role} asks for engagement terms for a commercial valuation and pastes the owning company's details and director.
text: Instruction letter for a commercial valuation: {{company}} (ACN {{au-acn}}) owns the warehouse at {{au-address}}, sole director {{au-name}}. Purpose is mortgage security. Draft the engagement terms.

label: violation
policy_basis: A New Tax System (Australian Business Number) Act 1999
description: A {role} asks whether a contractor's ABN is still active and pastes the number.
text: Is ABN {{au-abn}} still active for this landscaper? He's invoiced us twice.

label: violation
description: A {role} pastes a client's quoted email containing ID numbers and asks for a reply to be tidied.

label: violation
description: A {role} pastes a newsletter draft that contains an undisclosed referral commission arrangement in the middle of it.
text: Polish this newsletter paragraph. 'It was a strong quarter for the group, with listings up 12% and clearance rates holding in the low 70s. Our referral arrangement with {{company}} pays us 0.8% on every loan settled, fixed until 2028, and the franchisor still doesn't know about it, so keep that quiet. Thanks to everyone who ran open homes.'

label: violation
policy_basis: OWASP Secrets Management; NIST SP 800-53 SC-7
description: A {role} pastes a compose file with a database URL and cloud key inline to debug a worker that will not start.
text:
Compose file won't start the worker, what's wrong?

services:
  worker:
    image: crm-sync:latest
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: {{secret:conn}}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: {{secret:aws}}
      SYNC_HOST: crm-sync-01.corp.internal

  redis:
    image: redis:7
